sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM
    marts.fct_orders

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM
    marts.fct_orders

WITH orders_2017 AS (
    SELECT o.order_value
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
      ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2017
)
SELECT SUM(order_value) AS total_revenue_2017
FROM orders_2017

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS canceled_or_unavailable_orders
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    is_canceled = TRUE
    OR order_status = 'canceled'
    OR order_status = 'unavailable'

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM
    marts.dim_sellers
WHERE
    state = 'Paraná'

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    customer_city = 'São Paulo'

SELECT
    AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    review_score IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT category_name) AS distinct_category_count
FROM
    marts.dim_products
WHERE
    category_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    SUM(o.freight_value) AS total_freight_2018
FROM
    marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE
    o.is_canceled = FALSE
    AND o.purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-01' AND DATE '2018-12-31'

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS boleto_order_count
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    primary_payment_type = 'boleto'

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS customers_with_at_least_two_non_canceled_orders
FROM (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id
    FROM 
        marts.fct_orders
    WHERE 
        is_canceled = FALSE
    GROUP BY 
        customer_unique_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(*) >= 2
) AS sub

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS late_delivery_rate_pct
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE is_delivered = TRUE

SELECT
    AVG(o.order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM
    marts.fct_orders AS o
JOIN
    marts.dim_date AS d
    ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE
    d.year = 2018

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS products_over_10kg
FROM
    marts.dim_products
WHERE
    product_weight_g > 10000

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS one_star_order_count
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    review_score = 1

SELECT
    state,
    COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM marts.dim_sellers
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY seller_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH orders_2017 AS (
    SELECT
        o.items_value,
        o.freight_value,
        d.quarter
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2017
)
SELECT
    quarter,
    SUM(COALESCE(items_value, 0) + COALESCE(freight_value, 0)) AS total_billed_amount
FROM orders_2017
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter

SELECT
    o.customer_state AS state,
    SUM(o.order_value)      AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
  ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE d.year = 2018
  AND o.is_canceled = FALSE
GROUP BY o.customer_state
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    SUM(oi.item_total_value) AS revenue_health_beauty_2017
FROM
    marts.fct_order_items AS oi
WHERE
    oi.category_name = 'health & beauty'
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM oi.purchase_date) = 2017
    AND oi.is_canceled = FALSE

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS late_orders
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    customer_state = 'Rio de Janeiro'
    AND is_late = TRUE

WITH orders_2017 AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.delivery_days,
        d.year_month,
        d.month
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2017
      AND o.is_delivered = TRUE
      AND o.is_canceled = FALSE
)
SELECT
    year_month AS month,
    ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders_2017
GROUP BY year_month, month
ORDER BY month

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1 END) 
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS credit_card_share_pct
FROM marts.fct_order_payments

SELECT
    payment_type AS payment_method,
    SUM(payment_value) AS total_amount_paid
FROM marts.fct_order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    EXTRACT(year FROM o.purchased_at) AS year,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_canceled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_rate_percent
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS customers_first_order_2018
FROM
    marts.dim_customers
WHERE
    DATE_PART('year', first_order_at) = 2018

SELECT
    category_name AS category,
    AVG(price) AS average_item_price
FROM marts.fct_order_items
WHERE is_canceled = FALSE
GROUP BY category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY average_item_price DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS orders_with_more_than_3_items
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    item_count > 3

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_credit_card_10plus_installments
FROM marts.fct_order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS active_sellers_2018
FROM
    marts.fct_order_items AS oi
JOIN
    marts.dim_date AS d
    ON oi.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE
    d.year = 2018
    AND oi.is_canceled = FALSE

SELECT
    SUM(order_value) AS total_amount_billed
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-08-01' AND DATE '2018-08-31'

WITH orders_2017 AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        d.month,
        d.month_name
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2017
)
SELECT
    month_name AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_placed
FROM orders_2017
GROUP BY month, month_name
ORDER BY orders_placed DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT oi.*
    FROM marts.fct_order_items AS oi
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
      ON oi.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2018
      AND oi.category_name IN ('bed', 'bath', 'table')
      AND oi.is_canceled = FALSE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS units_sold
FROM filtered

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        delivered_to_customer_at,
        estimated_delivery_at
    FROM marts.fct_orders
    WHERE is_delivered = TRUE
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE 
                       WHEN delivered_to_customer_at < estimated_delivery_at THEN 1 
                       ELSE 0 
                   END) 
        / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS early_delivery_pct
FROM delivered_orders

SELECT 
    median(delivery_days) AS median_delivery_days
FROM 
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE 
    is_delivered = TRUE

SELECT
    SUM(o.order_value) AS southeast_revenue
FROM
    marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE
    o.customer_state IN ('SP', 'RJ', 'MG', 'ES')
    AND o.is_canceled = FALSE

WITH orders_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_unique_id,
        d.year
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
      ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
)
SELECT
    year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM orders_by_year
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

SELECT
    o.primary_payment_type AS payment_method,
    AVG(o.review_score)        AS avg_review_score
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.primary_payment_type
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC

WITH avg_delivery AS (
    SELECT
        customer_state,
        AVG(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days
    FROM marts.fct_orders
    WHERE is_delivered = TRUE
    GROUP BY customer_state
)
SELECT
    customer_state AS state,
    avg_delivery_days
FROM avg_delivery
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS orders_delivered_2018
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    is_delivered = TRUE
    AND delivered_to_customer_at >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
    AND delivered_to_customer_at <  TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'

SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM purchased_at) AS order_hour,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_placed
FROM marts.fct_orders
GROUP BY order_hour
ORDER BY orders_placed DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue_2018_5star
FROM
    marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE
    o.review_score = 5
    AND o.purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-01' AND DATE '2018-12-31'

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        category_name,
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2017-01-01' AND DATE '2017-08-31' 
                THEN item_total_value 
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS revenue_2017,
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-01-01' AND DATE '2018-08-31' 
                THEN item_total_value 
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS revenue_2018
    FROM marts.fct_order_items
    WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2017-01-01' AND DATE '2018-08-31'
    GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT
    category_name      AS category,
    revenue_2017,
    revenue_2018,
    (revenue_2018 - revenue_2017) AS absolute_growth
FROM category_revenue
ORDER BY absolute_growth DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
    AVG(date_diff('day', CAST(first_order_at AS DATE), CAST(last_order_at AS DATE))) AS avg_days_between_first_last
FROM
    marts.dim_customers
WHERE
    is_repeat_customer = TRUE

WITH items_2017 AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        item_total_value
    FROM marts.fct_order_items
    WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN DATE '2017-01-01' AND DATE '2017-12-31'
      AND is_canceled = FALSE
),
total_rev AS (
    SELECT SUM(item_total_value) AS total_revenue
    FROM items_2017
),
seller_rev AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        SUM(item_total_value) AS seller_revenue
    FROM items_2017
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT SUM(seller_revenue) AS top10_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT seller_revenue
        FROM seller_rev
        ORDER BY seller_revenue DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ) t
)
SELECT
    top10.top10_revenue / total_rev.total_revenue AS revenue_share
FROM top10, total_rev

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        d.year_month AS month,
        SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2018
      AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY d.year_month
    ORDER BY d.year_month
)
SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
        / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_change_vs_prev_month
FROM monthly_revenue

WITH state_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        customer_state AS state,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        AVG(order_value) AS average_order_value
    FROM marts.fct_orders
    GROUP BY customer_state
)
SELECT
    state,
    average_order_value
FROM state_metrics
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH orders_2017 AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM marts.fct_orders
    WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM purchase_date) = 2017
),
payment_counts AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_cnt
    FROM marts.fct_order_payments
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders_2017)
    GROUP BY order_id
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders_2017
),
multi AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS multi_orders
    FROM payment_counts
    WHERE payment_cnt > 1
)
SELECT
    multi.multi_orders::DECIMAL / total.total_orders AS proportion_multi_payment
FROM total, multi

WITH category_seller_counts AS (
    SELECT
        category_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS distinct_seller_count
    FROM marts.fct_order_items
    WHERE category_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT
    category_name AS product_category,
    distinct_seller_count
FROM category_seller_counts
ORDER BY distinct_seller_count DESC, product_category
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers_2017
FROM
    marts.dim_customers
WHERE
    EXTRACT(year FROM first_order_at) = 2017
    AND order_count > 1

WITH orders_2018 AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_value,
        o.primary_payment_type
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2018
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN primary_payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN order_value ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(order_value), 0) AS credit_card_fraction
FROM orders_2018

WITH non_canceled AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_items,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN seller_state = customer_state THEN 1 END) AS same_state_items
    FROM marts.fct_order_items
    WHERE is_canceled = FALSE
)
SELECT
    same_state_items * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_items, 0) AS share_sold_items_same_state_pct
FROM non_canceled

WITH orders_weekend AS (
    SELECT
        o.review_score,
        d.is_weekend
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    JOIN marts.dim_date AS d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE o.review_score IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
    ROUND(AVG(review_score)::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM orders_weekend
GROUP BY day_type
ORDER BY day_type
